metadata.name: GetServiceCharges
metadata.description: This API gets all service charges associated with with a Service Charge plan for a merchant.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Specific ID Assigned to a Merchant, Mandatory If Merchant Number not Inputted in API Request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: 562489

request_fields.name: PrimaryCurrencyCode
request_fields.description: 3 digit Code assiciated with the Currency Valid Values: Refer Primary Currency Code section of Appendix Format: XXX Example: 840 Allowable Values: 3

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TierCriteriaAccountBalanceUnder
children.description: Indicates the amount of account balance to consider for this late fee tier. All parameters for that tier then apply. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxx Example: 500

children.name: LateFeeTiming
children.description: Indicates whether or not a late fee should be assessed, and if so, the method of timing the assessment. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Late Fee Parameters Format: xxxx xx xxxx

children.name: LateFeeBaseDate
children.description: Indicates how to calculate the late fee date; this entry plus the number entered in the Late Fee Days field determines when a late fee is assessed on a delinquent account. Valid Values:  Refer Appendix Late Fee Parameters Format: xxxx xx xxxx

children.name: LateFeeDays
children.description: Identifies the number of days added to the Payment Due Date, Current Cycle Date, or Next Statement Date to determine when a late fee is assessed on a delinquent account. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Late Fee Parameters Format: xx

children.name: LateFeeDelinquencyCycle
children.description: Identifies the cycle delinquency level to determine when to start assessing a late fee. This field is required if a value is entered in the Late Fee Percent field. Valid Values:  Refer Appendix Late Fee Parameters Format: xx

children.name: MaximumNumberLateFeesOption
children.description: Indicates if the maximum number of late fees flags are being used. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Late Fee Parameters Format: xxx

children.name: LateFeeConsecutiveLimit
children.description: Identifies the maximum number of consecutive late fees permitted on an account. Once this number is reached, the system skips a cycle before assessing another late fee. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Late Fee Parameters Format: xxx

children.name: LateFeeMinimumBalance
children.description: Identifies the minimum balance on an account that can be assessed a late fee. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxx Example:  500

children.name: LateFeeMinimumAmount
children.description: Identifies the minimum amount of a single late fee for an account. This amount must be less than the value in the Late Fee Maximum Amount field. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxx Example:  500

children.name: LateFeeMaximumAmount1
children.description: Identifies the maximum late fee amount that can be assessed on an account in this service charge plan. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxx Example:  500

children.name: LateFeeMaximumYearToDate
children.description: Identifies the total amount of late fees that can be assessed on an account year to date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxx Example:  500

children.name: MaximumNumberLateFees
children.description: Identifies the maximum number of late fees that can be assessed on an account in a year. for this late fee tier. All parameters for that tier then apply. Valid Values: 0-12 Format: xxx Example: 1 Allowable Values: 5

children.name: LateFeeTransactionCode
children.description: Identifies the transaction code to use to process late fees. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Late Fee Parameters Format: xxx Example:  500

children.name: LateFeeMaximumAmount2
children.description: Identifies the maximum late fee amount that can be assessed on an account when the Maximum Amount 2 Criteria is met. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxx Example:  500

children.name: MaximumAmount2Criteria
children.description: Indicates the criteria that should be met to make the Late Fee Maximum Amount 2 applicable. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Late Fee Parameters Format: xxx Example:  500

children.name: LateFeeCalculationBasis
children.description: Identifies the calculation basis used to assess late fees. When Minimum Due Amount is selected, you are not allowed to enter a value in Late Fee Percent or Late Fee Amount. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Late Fee Calculation Format: xxx

children.name: LateFeePercent
children.description: Identifies the percentage used to calculate late fees. Required if you selected Percent, Amount and Percent, Greater of Amount or Percent, or Lesser of Amount or Percent in the Late Fee Calculation Basis field. If you selected Minimum due amount in the Late Fee Calculation Basis field, you cannot enter a value in this field. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: x Example: 5

children.name: LateFeeAmount
children.description: Identifies the currency amount to assess as a late charge. This amount must be within the range defined by the Late Fee Minimum Amount field and the Late Fee Maximum Amount field. Required if you selected Amount, Amount and Percent, Greater of Amount or Percent, or Lesser of Amount or Percent in the Late Fee Calculation Basis field. If you selected Minimum due amount in the Late Fee Calculation Basis field, you cannot enter a value in this field. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: x Example: 5

children.name: LateFeePercentMethod

children.name: BalanceSubjecttoLateFeeControl

children.name: OverlimitFeeMaximumAmount1
children.description: Identifies the maximum overlimit fee amount that can be assessed on an account in this service charge plan. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx

children.name: OverlimitFeeMaximumAmount2
children.description: Identifies the maximum overlimit fee amount that can be assessed on an account when the Maximum Amount 2 Criteria is met. This is an optional field, but should be greater than 0 if a selection is made in the Maximum Amount 2 Criteria field. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 500

children.name: OverlimitFeeMinimumAmount
children.description: Identifies the minimum amount of a single overlimit fee. This amount must be less than the value in the Overlimit Fee Maximum Amount field. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 500

children.name: OverlimitFeesMaximumYearToDate
children.description: Identifies the maximum number of overlimit fees that can be assessed on an account year to date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 500

children.name: OverlimitFeeMaximumAmount2Criteria
children.description: Indicates the criteria that should be met to make the Overlimit Fee Maximum Amount 2 applicable. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Overlimit Fees Format: xxxxx Example: 500

children.name: OverLimitFeeTrancode
children.description: Identifies the tran code to use to post overlimit fees. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Overlimit Fees Format: xxxxx Example: 1852154

children.name: OverlimitFeeCalculationBasis
children.description: Indicates how overlimit fees are calculated. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Overlimit Fees Format: xxxxx

children.name: OverlimitFeeAmount
children.description: Identifies the currency amount assessed as an overlimit fee. This amount must be within the minimum/maximum range. This amount must be greater than zero when the value in the Overlimit Fee Calculation Basis field is not Percent. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 500

children.name: OverlimitPercent
children.description: Identifies the percentage of the balance assessed as the overlimit fee. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 12

children.name: AllowedOverlimitPercent
children.description: Identifies the percentage of the credit line that the account is allowed to exceed before an overlimit fee is assessed. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 12

children.name: OverlimitFeesMaximumCycleToDate
children.description: Identifies the maximum number of overlimit fees that can be assessed on an account cycle to date. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Overlimit Fees Format: xxxxx

children.name: InsufficientFundsFeeCalculationBasis
children.description: Indicates how insufficient funds fees are calculated for accounts in this service charge plan. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Insufficient Fund Fees Format: xxxxx

children.name: InsufficientFundsFeeAmount
children.description: Identifies the currency amount of the fee charged on the insufficient funds payment. This amount must be within the minimum or maximum range and must be greater than zero when the value in the Insufficient Funds Fee Calculation Basis field is not Percent. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 500

children.name: InsufficientFundsFeePercent
children.description: Identifies the percentage of the insufficient funds payment to be assessed as an insufficient funds charge. This percentage must be greater than zero when the value in the Insufficient Funds Calculation Basis field is not Amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 15

children.name: InsufficientFundsFeeMaximum1
children.description: Identifies the maximum amount charged for an insufficient funds payment. This amount must be greater than the Insufficient Funds Fee Minimum value. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 500

children.name: InsufficientFundsFeeMaximum2
children.description: Identifies the maximum insufficient funds fee amount that can be assessed on an account when the Maximum Amount 2 Criteria is met. This is an optional field, but should be greater than 0 if a selection is made in the Maximum Amount 2 Criteria field. This amount cannot be less than the amount defined in the Insufficient Funds Fees Minimum field. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx Example: 500

children.name: InsufficientFundsFeeMaximumAmount2Criteria
children.description: Indicates the criteria that should be met to make the Insufficient Funds Fees Amount 2 applicable. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Insufficient Fund Fees Format: xxxxx Example: 500

children.name: TransactionFeeNumberforFree
children.description: Identifies the number of transactions or services that are provided for free (before a fee is assessed). If this field is left at its default value (null), the fee is always generated if the Incoming Transaction Code occurs on the account. If this field is set to a value between 1 and 10, the system allows this number of occurrences of the Incoming Transaction Code to happen on the account in the selected Timeframe before the fee is assessed. Valid Values: The values are Null and 1 through 10. Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 5

children.name: TransactionFeeTimeframe
children.description: Identifies the designated timeframe connected to the Number for Free services or transactions. Valid Values: NULL, Per Day, Per Week, Per Cycle, Per Year, Per Lifetime, Per Load. Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 5

children.name: TransactionFeeRecurring
children.description: Indicates if this fee is recurring; i.e., one transaction may generate two or more fees based on one transaction event. If set to Yes, you must also use the following two Duration fields to set the number of times the fee recurs, and the time period on which to base the occurrence. Valid Values: Yes/No Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 100

children.name: TransactionFeeDuration
children.description: The number of times the fee recurs and when (indicated in the Duration Period field). Required when Recurring = Yes. Valid Values: The values are 2 through 12. Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 5

children.name: TransactionFeeDurationPeriod
children.description: The time period on which to base the occurrence. Required when Recurring = Yes. Valid Values: Week, Month, Cycle, Quarter, Year Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 5

children.name: TransactionFeeDeleteIfZeroBalance
children.description: Indicates if any recurring fees should be deleted if the account and plan balance reach zero or less than zero. Required when Recurring = Yes. Valid Values: No = Do not delete fees. Account = The system deletes the recurring fee if the account balance becomes zero or negative. Plan = The system deletes the recurring fee if the plan balance becomes zero or negative. Allowable Values: 100

children.description: Identifies the calculation method for this transaction fee. Valid Values: Assess Flat Amount, Assess Percentage Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 100

children.name: TransactionFeeRate1Amount
children.description: Identifies the flat fee amount the system should use to calculate this fee. If the Fee Calculation Method field is set to Assess Flat Amount, enter the value to represent the whole currency amount of the fee. Valid Values: The values are 1 through 999. Format: xxxxx

children.name: TransactionFeeRate1Percent
children.description: Identifies the flat fee percentage the system should use to calculate this fee. If the Fee Calculation Method field is set to Assess Percentage, enter the value to represent the percentage the system should use to calculate the fee. Valid Values: The values are 1 through 100. Format: xxxxx

children.name: TransactionFeeRate1AmountOrPercentLimit
children.description: Identifies the flat fee percentage the system should use to calculate this fee. If the Fee Calculation Method field is set to Assess Percentage, enter the value to represent the percentage the system should use to calculate the fee. Valid Values: The values are 1 through 100. Format: xxxxx

children.name: TransactionFeeRate1LimitPeriod
children.description: Identifies the timeframe associated with the Rate 1 Amount or Percent field. If you enter a value in the Rate 1 Amount or Percent field, you must select a value in this field. Valid Values: Day, Week, Cycle, Year, Occurrence = Use Rate 1 Amount or Percent for recurring fees up the number defined in the Occurrence field. Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 5

children.name: TransactionFeeOccurrence
children.description: Sets the recurring fee limit used for Rate 1 Amount or Percent. Any recurring fees above this occurrence use Rate 2 Amount or Percent. The number selected must be less than the number selected in the Dur # field. This field is used only when Recurring = Yes. Valid Values: The values are 1 through 11. Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 5

children.name: TransactionFeeRate2Amount
children.description: Enter the second amount the system should use to generate the fee if the Rate 1 Limit is attained within the Rate 1 Limit Period. If you defined a Rate 1 Amount, you must set this field to a value. This value can be less than or greater than the Rate 1 Amount but cannot be equal to the Rate 1 Amount. Both fields are governed by the Fee Calculation Method; you cannot provide a flat amount as one rate and a percentage amount in the second rate. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx

children.name: TransactionFeeRate2Percent
children.description: Enter the second percentage the system should use to generate the fee if the Rate 1 Limit is attained within the Rate 1 Limit Period. If you defined a Rate 1 Percent, you must set this field to a value. This value can be less than or greater than the Rate 1 Percent but cannot be equal to the Rate 1 Percent. Both fields are governed by the Fee Calculation Method; you cannot provide a flat amount as one rate and a percentage amount in the second rate. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx

children.name: TransactionFeeMinFeeAmount
children.description: Enter the minimum fee that should be charged if the calculated fee based on a percentage is less than this amount. If no minimum fee is entered, the system charges the calculated fee unless there is a maximum fee parameter to consider. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx

children.name: TransactionFeeMaxFeeAmount
children.description: Enter the maximum fee that should be charged if the calculated fee based on a percentage is greater than this amount. If no maximum fee is entered, the system should charge the calculated fee unless there is a minimum fee parameter to consider. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xxxxx

children.name: ReverseTransactionFees
children.description: Indicates if this fee should be reversed if the original transaction that triggered the fee was reversed (as opposed to automatically reversing all fees if the transaction is reversed). Valid Values: Yes- Reverse Fee when the transaction is reversed/ No- Do Not Reverse Fee when the transaction is reversed Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 100

Valid Values: Account = This fee is assessed at the account level only. Card = This fee is assessed at the card level; therefore, one fee is assessed for the Primary cardholder and a second fee is assessed for the Secondary cardholder. If you set this field to Card, you must also define the Cardholder field. If the Fee Type is set to Inactive, this field is disabled. Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 1

You are only allowed one fee for the Primary cardholder and one fee for the Secondary cardholder. Valid Values: Primary/Secondary Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 1

Valid Values: Each = The system generates the active/inactive fee for each Secondary cardholder with a Card Status of Active each time the account qualifies for an Active fee. All = The system generates just one active/inactive fee if there are any Secondary cardholders with a Card Status of Active each time the account qualifies for an active fee. If the Cardholder field is set to null values or Primary, this field is disabled. Allowable Values: 1

children.description: Indicates the period in which the account is inactive, if a selection has been made in the Account to be inactive for minimum field. Valid Values: Cycle, Year = This value is allowed when the Account to be inactive for minimum field is set to 1 through 7. Format: xxxxx Allowable Values: 5

children.name: MonthlyFeesList
children.description: get or set MonthlyFeesList

children.name: AssessMonthlyFees
children.description: Indicates whether the monthly fees will be assessed or not. Valid Values: 0, 1 0 = Yes, 1 = No Example: 0 Allowable Values: 1

children.name: MonthlyFeeAmount
children.description: Identifies the amount of the monthly fee in dollars. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 250

children.name: MonthlyFeeTransactionCode
children.description: It will show the transaction code mapped to Monthly Fee. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9, Special Characters Example: 14540010 = Monthly Fee Allowable Values: 100

children.name: MonthlyFeeFeeWaiverRuleID
children.description: It will show the Fee waiver rule ID for the Monthly Fees set at Program Setup. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 3456 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MonthlyFeeWaiverTransactionCode
children.description: It will show the transaction code mapped to Fee waiver transaction. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9, Special Characters Example: 1450105011 = Waived Monthly Fee Allowable Values: 100
